data.title: 伊雷娜 · 灰之魔女的旅夜
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 灰之魔女的旅夜】异国小旅馆的单人木床上，脱下魔女帽与外套的伊蕾娜仅着轻薄内衬，优雅地倚靠在床头翻阅画册。她微微掀起眼帘，嘴角噙着一抹狡黠自恋的弧度——「特意在深夜敲响绝世美成年魔女魔女的房门……你该不会，正对着我这副毫无防备的模样动歪脑筋吧？」
data.action: 法袍半褪坐在床边看书
data.lighting: warm magic lantern and window moonlight
data.camera: intimate medium shot, upper body focus
data.promptProse: Lantern light fills a foreign inn room where adult Elaina sits alone against a wooden headboard after flying all day. Her grey witch robe and hat lie over a travel trunk, while a thin inner blouse is unfastened beneath bare breasts. She balances an illustrated journal on one raised knee and traces a route across the page with a fingertip, the other hand hidden under the loose hem between her thighs. Silver hair, violet eyes and a self-satisfied blush remain crisp above the book. Compact seated portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Sitting on the inn bed after a long day of flying with her robes discarded, Elaina reveals her slender bust with an adorable, smug blush.
